- Improve “The House Within” with playable auditory and visual hallucinations, unusual beliefs, paranoia, and disorganized thoughts while preserving its suggestive, non-diagnostic approach.

- Preserve ambiguous events and ordinary explanations for unsettling moments.
- Make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions; briefly note them when finished.
- For visual checks, save a JPEG no wider than 1280px and inspect only the latest screenshot.

- Add a fleeting peripheral apparition that disappears when directly noticed.
- Trigger it occasionally after several encounters and elevated pressure, rather than making it a constant event.

content.text: Image read successfully

Added a fleeting peripheral apparition to `game.js`. It can appear after at least three encounters when pressure is elevated, fades when noticed directly, and resets when a new game starts.

**Checked:** `node --check game.js`, `git diff --check`, and a Playwright run with no browser errors. I inspected the latest 1280×800 JPEG; the game displays correctly. The apparition is occasional, so it isn’t visible in this static screenshot.

**Assumption:** The apparition should be subtle and rare, with no explanation that confirms whether it was real.
